subject: ACK Agent 03 final topology handoff
body: Acknowledged final topology handoff at HEAD 413d4a722fe8193f15ff086595f10d1464505ace. Agent01 incorporates the separation of physical panel identity/power, logical routing, and presentation readiness. Sensor geometry recommendations will not bind angle authority to logical display IDs, and FoldInteractive fallback recommendations will preserve topology fencing rather than persistent dual anchors.
